Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-polish-medium-0100", "row_sha256": "31a0cd5da3c2322cfa38a4e627e81d20a56fd2070934df446fb5213bff65bb93", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "the saturday rota for the riverside volunteer car is now put together for 12 july, with six drivers listed and the two vehicles being used. mara has the north clinic pickup from 8.10, and dev has the east estate collection at 8.30, while jo and lewis are down for the later hospital runs. the second car is with iman for the library stop and the food shop trips, but she is only available until 1.30. the drivers have the updated phone list, although the printed copy in the hall still has last month's number for the garage.

two passengers asked for step-free access. the smaller car cannot take the folding ramp, so their trips are shown against the minibus, subject to confirming that it is back from inspection by friday. if it is not returned, the coordinator will need to call both passengers before changing either booking. no one has been assigned the spare afternoon slot yet; nora said she may cover it if her appointment finishes early, but she has not confirmed.

the rota looks workable for the listed journeys, provided the minibus is available and the morning pickups remain within the times given. that assessment covers only the bookings already on the sheet, not any requests that come in later.", "output": "The Saturday rota for the Riverside volunteer car has been drawn up for 12 July, with six drivers listed and two vehicles in use. Mara has the North Clinic pickup at 8.10, and Dev has the East Estate collection at 8.30. Jo and Lewis are assigned the later hospital runs. Iman has the second car for the library stop and food shop trips, but she is available only until 1.30. The drivers have the updated phone list, although the printed copy in the hall still has last month's garage number.

Two passengers have asked for step-free access. The smaller car cannot take the folding ramp, so their trips are listed for the minibus, subject to confirmation that it will be back from inspection by Friday. If it is not returned, the coordinator will need to call both passengers before changing either booking. The spare afternoon slot has not yet been assigned. Nora said she may cover it if her appointment finishes early, but she has not confirmed.

The rota looks workable for the listed journeys, provided the minibus is available and the morning pickups remain within the times given. This assessment covers only the bookings already on the sheet, not any requests that come in later."}]
